Rock, paper, scissors against CSS

Play 30 rounds. A model made of 6,067 CSS custom properties learns your habits while you play and picks what beats your next move. 0 bytes of JavaScript.

youvsCSS
youdrawsCSS
Top: you. Bottom: CSS. Green: you won, orange: CSS won.

Inside the model

Fifteen experts each guess your next move. Each one scores +1 when its guess would have won and −1 when it would have lost, over the last 6 rounds. The best one decides. Its guess for the next round stays hidden, or you would see my move coming.

Each cell: its guess last round, and its score now. Outlined: the expert that decided last round. +1 and +2 assume you are trying to outguess me.
